name: Beatrix Brehme
original_name: ベアトリクス・ブレーメ
source: Major Beatrix Brehme is the primary antagonist of Schwarzesmarken and main heroine of Bernhard im Schatten. Commander of the Stasi's infamous Wehrwolf Battalion, and one of the strongest pilots in Europe. With her as commander, Beatrix and her battalion became the symbol of Stasi induced fear in East Germany, as ruthless and brutal hunters of deserters, anti-government dissidents, and emigrants fleeing to the West.
